note: Sizes are data: change them for your budget and your machine. Every report states the settings its runs used. These are the sizes of the 3D jobs of 2026-11-21 (a 3D view, physics and sound), larger than the 2D jobs' because a build without an engine has more to write.

runner.note: How 'examen leverage run' starts a builder or a judge: one process, in the run's folder, that takes a prompt, runs to its end and prints what it used. {prompt} and {model} are filled in. This one is Claude Code's, with six tools and no MCP servers; put your own agent's command line here, or start agents yourself and use 'record'.

rules: Someone may be using this machine: open no window that takes the keyboard or comes to the front, and never move the pointer or press keys for them.
Anything you start that listens, listens on 127.0.0.1 only.
Stop every process you started before you finish.
Write a file with your file-writing tool, never with a shell here-document: on this machine a here-document is refused when its text holds an apostrophe, and what was written into it is lost.
